scripts.check: pnpm --filter @tempoxyz/contracts check && vp lint --deny-warnings e2e localnet vite.config.ts && vp fmt --check '.github/**' README.md SKILL.md SECURITY.md CONTRIBUTING.md 'docs/**' '**/AGENTS.md' '!**/lib/**' 'profiles/**' 'e2e/**' 'localnet/**' vite.config.ts package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml
scripts.coverage: mkdir -p out/coverage && FOUNDRY_PROFILE=coverage forge coverage --no-match-coverage '^script/' --report-file out/coverage/lcov.info
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @tempoxyz/contracts test --run && pnpm --filter localnet test --run && pnpm --filter e2e test --run
scripts.test:contracts: FOUNDRY_PROFILE=ci forge test && FOUNDRY_PROFILE=spend-ci forge test
scripts.verify:contracts: forge fmt --check && forge lint --deny warnings --out out/lint --cache-path cache/lint && pnpm lint:zone-spend && forge build src script test && pnpm --filter @tempoxyz/contracts abis:check && FOUNDRY_PROFILE=deploy forge build --sizes src/earn/core/EarnVault.sol && pnpm test:contracts && pnpm gas:snapshot
scripts.verify:typescript: pnpm check && pnpm check:types && pnpm test
scripts.lint:zone-spend: FOUNDRY_PROFILE=lint-zone-spend forge lint --deny warnings --out out/lint --cache-path cache/lint src/zone src/interfaces/zone src/spend/CardFactory.sol src/spend/CardSpend.sol src/spend/CardSpender.sol src/interfaces/spend src/spend/providers/rain src/spend/providers/bridge/BridgeProvider.sol
